ideas.pitch: An AI-powered campus event discovery and peer coordination engine built for elite engineering campuses like IITs and NITs.
ideas.title: CampusPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with winning education platforms like aura by targeting college students directly, presenting a polished UI and practical utility that resonates with student judges and the Audience Favourite voting pool.

ideas.pitch: A co-creation coding social network designed for hackathon teammates to synchronously build, review, and merge code snippets using LLM-driven modular synthesis.
ideas.title: HiveVibe
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly channels the social coding philosophy of the hivecode win, showcasing high engineering complexity through real-time collaboration features.

ideas.pitch: An emergency triage and distress response system for large residential university campuses, featuring real-time transcripts and emotion-aware routing.
ideas.title: DispatchAI-Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the high-impact architecture of DispatcherAI, giving judges a dramatic live-demo cockpit that demonstrates deep technical execution under tight sprint conditions.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision sports biomechanics analyzer customized to evaluate athletic workout form for campus fitness centers using pose estimation.
ideas.title: FormMotion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven computer vision architecture of CricketVision_AI with MediaPipe Pose, ensuring a visually engaging and functional live demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI professional networking and mentorship concierge tailored for top-tier Indian engineering alumni and student placement cells.
ideas.title: ConciergeAI-India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the hybrid intelligence framework from the Franklink win, solving a relatable placement networking problem for students from IITs, NITs, IIITs, and BITS.
